baseline_rule: configuration validity only (asset moves, canonical motion, defender masked, no interception, CRN, determinism); difficulty is documented and never used to modify the environment

failed_stage4.result: 0/3 mastered; held-out capture 52.5 / 60.5 / 59.5 %; repeated fly-bys at ~3.4 m miss distance, endurance exhaustion 17-23 %
failed_stage4.status: non-canonical evidence; checkpoints never used here

decomposition.next_stage_if_pass: Stage 4B = moving asset + Stage3-v2 hold-until-detection Greedy + C0 (not started here)

asset_motion.rng_stream: SeedSequence(seed).spawn(4)[1] (`_rng_soldier`), one normal(0, sigma, size=2) draw per step

environment.common_random_numbers: same evaluation seed => same initial attacker state, same asset state and the same asset random walk (dedicated `_rng_soldier` stream) for A0, the Stage3-v2 parent and the Stage-4A policy; asserted by tests and by the baseline CRN report (also against the Stage-4 environment)
environment.defender: structurally present, stationary, parked at the Stage-1 ground corner (-48,-48,0), never acts; observation masked unavailable (defender flag/position/velocity slots exactly 0); interception impossible (intercept_radius = 1e-6 m) - the established Stage-1-v2 mechanism, reused unchanged
environment.geometry: Stage-1-v2: canonical perimeter spawn, altitude U(10, 30), initial heading offset U(0, 90) deg

hypothesis: The Stage-4 failure is primarily caused by insufficient moving-target pursuit competence rather than loss of defender-evasion skill. Isolating canonical moving-target pursuit should allow the curriculum policy to acquire tracking competence before the moving defender is reintroduced.

initialization.actor_critic_log_std: policy state_dict of the matching accepted Stage3-v2 checkpoint (actor, CRITIC, log_std)

mastery: two consecutive rollout validations pass ALL gate checks
observation_audit: a1_v2_obs_v1 (37-D) unchanged: it carries the CURRENT asset position; the walk is memoryless so no future/asset-velocity feature is needed and none is exposed.

parents.note: accepted Stage3-v2 curriculum checkpoints (NOT the failed Stage-4 models); remain curriculum models, not final A1

retention.stop: capture below the anchor minimum on 2 consecutive rollouts on ANY anchor => CURRICULUM_RETENTION_FAILURE

reward: a1_v2_reward_v2 unchanged (no moving-target shaping, no prediction/velocity-matching term, no A0 fallback)
success_rule: >= 2/3 seeds master, moving-target tracking improves (mastered seeds: paired Stage4A - parent capture CI lower bound > 0 AND repeated fly-by rate below the parent's), anchors retained, no shared pathology (same category in > 1 % of episodes for >= 2 seeds); < 2 mastered => STOP, do not reintroduce the defender
tests: curriculum decomposition of Stage 4: moving-target pursuit only (no active defender)

validation.alternation: rollout k: odd -> A, even -> B
validation.final: 169000-169199 (200 episodes) + matched canonical A0 + matched Stage3-v2 parent (common random numbers)
validation.suggested_block_conflict: 166000-166199 is occupied by the Stage-4 retention anchors; the next clean contiguous blocks are used

verdict_B_rule: not passed AND (>= 1 seed mastered OR >= 2 seeds with held-out capture >= 0.90 and paired CI lower bound > 0 vs the parent)
